items.name: showreel-pv-web-typescale
items.title: One number sets every text size (×1.25)
items.about: A type scale stacks on top as cards (13, 16, 20, 25, 39 px) while an invented plant shop's page below grows each size live; a quick 'no scale' flip, then ×1.333 for a louder brand, then a save card.
items.techniques: split screen, stacking cards with exact values, the page changing live per card, glossy silk background in the active colour, word-by-word captions with the key word in colour, a new state every ~1 s; ends on a line worth sending (research 23 Nov, P1).

items.name: showreel-pv-c3-poster
items.title: Fix this poster live: 5 fixes
items.about: A loud school bake-sale poster on a brick wall, its five problems ringed; one font, three sizes, one edge, grouping, one colour land as cards with values, the poster fixing itself with each; before/after flip; a 5-step save list.
items.techniques: split screen, fix cards stacking with exact values (54/22/14 px, 26 px, #C8402A), the design changing live, silk background in each fix's colour, word-by-word captions, a FIX n/5 dial, ~1.5 s per fix; ends on a line worth sending (research 23 Nov, P1).

items.name: showreel-tech-ai-memory-r4
items.title: Tech kit, next step: the memory reel again (r4)
items.about: The posted memory reel rebuilt on the improved tech kit, to compare: the count now snaps to 4 GB and 8 GB, the first 8 seconds use three camera angles, the server hall shows real server racks, the memory module sits in a tray that fills the frame, and every cut has its own sound. The posted reel is not changed.
items.techniques: count in half a second landing on the spoken number, low macro and three-quarter framings, server rack faces with drive bays and status lights, a tray of modules to the bottom of the frame, swell and low hit on each cut, a riser that crests on RAM.

items.name: showreel-pv-web-homebar2
items.title: Web kit, next step: the home bar reel again
items.about: Yesterday's home bar reel rebuilt on the new hook kit, same voice: the app now falls away to the home screen on the first tap (0.3 s) and again at 1.3 s, a red word marks it (gone!, again?!), a counter shows TAPS 3 / SAVED 0, the swipe zone is drawn when the voice names it, and the fix ends on SAVED · 1 TAP. The posted reel is not changed.
items.techniques: the bug inside the first half second and again before 2 s, reaction words where it happens, a measurement in the hook's place, the cause marked on screen, a low hit on each failure; the black look from the kit.

items.name: showreel-pv-c3-resume2
items.title: Turns Out kit, next step: the CV reel again
items.about: The posted CV reel rebuilt after your note on the voice and the 'before'. The before is now an ordinary first draft (every line one size, the way a blank document starts). The voice speaks full sentences with a breath after each ("First, make the name the biggest."). The camera goes in a little on each fix, and the last frame shows a small BEFORE next to the AFTER. The posted reel is not changed.
items.techniques: a believable before with one common mistake, spoken sentences with breaths, each line landing on its change, a close-up on each fix, a before flash and a BEFORE thumbnail on the last frame.

items.name: showreel-pv-c3-greytext2
items.title: Turns Out, rebuilt: the grey menu
items.about: The held grey-text reel rebuilt after your note. The before is now a real choice people make: soft light-grey text on a cream menu, readable but tiring (about 2.4 to 1), not text too faint to exist. The voice speaks full sentences with breaths. The contrast checker now turns from FAIL to PASS (it stayed on FAIL in the old one), and the last frame shows BEFORE next to AFTER.
items.techniques: a believable before with one common mistake, spoken sentences with breaths, a close-up on each fix, a working contrast checker, a before flash and a BEFORE thumbnail on the last frame.
